name: Gachimuchi de Dosukebe na Kateikyoushi no Onii-san to Sugosu Haru
original_name: ガチムチでドスケベな家庭教師のお兄さんと過ごす春
source:
As the seasons changed and the time for cherry blossoms to bloom drew near.

Hibiki Ryouta, who had found a new dream and decided to re-challenge himself with the university entrance exams, and Kenzaki Atsushi, who became his tutor and boyfriend to support him.

Ryouta, who successfully passed the university exams, is given a tour of the university by Atsushi during the spring break. At that time, Ryouta coincidentally reunites with his high school best friend, Toramaru Iori. The two catch up on nostalgic topics such as memories from their time in the baseball club and begin to reconnect.

However! Iori turns out to be a perverted guy who has been fervently masturbating to Ryouta as his fantasy! On top of that, unbeknownst to Ryouta, a fierce battle of muscular penises erupts between Atsushi and Iori!?

translation:
随着季节的变化，樱花盛开的时间也越来越近了。

找到了新梦想并决定通过高考重新挑战自己的响亮太，以及支持他的导师兼男友的剑崎敦。

顺利通过大学考试的凉太在春假期间在敦的带领下参观了大学。就在这时，凉太巧合地与他高中时最好的朋友伊织虎丸重逢。两人聊起了一些怀旧的话题，比如在棒球俱乐部的回忆，并开始重新建立联系。

然而！伊织原来是一个一直以凉太为幻想自慰的变态！除此之外，在凉太不知情的情况下，Atsushi和Iori之间爆发了一场肌肉发达的激烈战斗！？
